rawItem.value: 1. Changing room shower floors and kerbs, including the recessed accessible shower bays, waterproofed bench supports and pipe penetrations. Turn the membrane up behind the wall lining, seal the interfaces with the floor drains and continue the protection beneath the entrance thresholds; 2. Library archive basement retaining walls, including wall to slab junctions, construction joints and service sleeves. The tanking must extend around the recessed book delivery entrance and terminate at the approved external ground level, with compatible seals where the wall meets the loading apron; 3. Sports hall equipment wash bays and their trapped drains, including cleaning cupboard floors and the wash down channels. Provide continuous waterproofing beneath equipment plinths and around the floor gully collars, and protect the membrane where maintenance trolleys pass between the wet bay and storage room; 4. Community hall catering preparation sinks, service trenches and splashback upstands, including the dishwashing recess and the small refrigerated store. Continue waterproofing through the trench junctions and under the counter legs, with sealed access covers and membrane returns at every wet area door; 5. Rainwater harvesting tank external faces, inspection sumps and connecting channels, including the tank base joints, pipe connection chambers and overflow route to the landscape drain; Include the waterproofed junctions at maintenance access openings and ensure that the protection boards do not obstruct the inspection or replacement of the access seals; 6. Courtyard fountain basin, overflow chamber and adjacent service duct, including the fountain pump recess and the cable entry sleeves. Waterproof the full basin wall and floor surfaces beneath the finishes, return the system over the perimeter edge and seal the movement joints separating the basin from the paved courtyard; 7. Loading bay ramps over the underground library store and associated movement joints, including the wheel guide plinths and drainage channel at the ramp foot. The waterproofing must continue behind the kerbs and around the store ventilation openings, with a traffic compatible wearing layer over all vehicle routes; 8. Caretaker block laundry balconies and clothes drying platforms, including the recessed washing machine positions and the shared laundry entrance; Include membrane returns around thresholds and drainage outlets, seal balustrade post fixings and continue the waterproofed surface beneath the removable service platforms used to maintain the washing machine supply pipes; 9. Green roof planting troughs over the community hall foyer and their perimeter upstands, including the irrigation valve pockets and emergency overflow outlets. The waterproofing must include compatible root resistant protection, continuous seals at trough corners and accessible inspection zones around every drain outlet.
rawItem.reason: The source explicitly provides a complete nine-item specification list for other waterproofing areas, with the governing statement that the list is complete.
